newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl says German growth won't reduce jobless toll.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says German growth won't reduce jobless toll.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Sunday he did not expect the gradual improvement in Germany's economy to have an impact on unemployment levels this year.
"We have every chance to progress some way economically this year and even further next year," Kohl said at a ceremony in the Bavarian town of Bad Woerishofen.
However, he added that the economic growth would not directly help to ease German joblessness, now hovering at levels not seen since the 1930s.
Kohl called on companies to offer more apprenticeships to young people.
"Investments in apprentices now are a deposit for social welfare in the future," he said.
